objective: Use authored structure geometry for review fortress collapse.
chosenApproach: Generate separate collapse prefabs matched to exact built-in source assets.
selectionRationale: Preserves strict static asset updater validation and existing gameplay.
alternativeApproaches: Attaching collapse components to updater model slots would violate the static asset contract.
preserveBehaviors: Existing structure combat, branch isolation and remote content validation
acceptanceChecks: Fragment lifecycle restores renderers and unrelated prefabs cannot select fragments.
